### Button

`src/components/Button/Button.tsx:66` · props `ButtonProps`

Central button. Kit variants are the noon app's filled/outline CTAs; `noon*` variants are 1:1 with bappzaar's NoonButton presets (`variant` primary/secondary × `type` default/ghost/dotted, `isLoading`, `renderBefore/After`, title-casing). Noon presets press like NoonButton (opacity 0.95 + scale 0.98, 200ms; ghost: none); override with `whileTap` / `transition`. Their rules are zero-specificity, so a caller `className` can restyle metrics.

| `size?` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | kit variants only — noon variants always use the NoonButton metrics |

| `loading?` | `boolean` | — | Kit variants: the spinner replaces the label. Noon variants (NoonButton `isLoading`): the label stays in place at opacity 0 and the loader is centred over the button, so the width never jumps. |

### HtmlText

`src/components/HtmlText/HtmlText.tsx:50` · props `HtmlTextProps`

Server-HTML text (bappzaar `<HtmlView>`): renders the custom inline tags the APIs send (`<b> <highlight> <green> <red> <orange> <steel> <strike> <h4> …`, `<br/>`; `<p>` wrappers are unwrapped). Two ways to style it, matching how the ported screens did it: - `stylesheet` — HtmlView's per-tag style map (checkout session copy, payment methods). - `base` + `className` — CSS sheets targeting `:global(highlight)` etc. (cart).

### NeedHelpButton

`src/components/NeedHelpButton/NeedHelpButton.tsx:20`

Floating "Need help?" pill (Accounts Figma 4NvyqO60K7Xn4gRJrkWmzQ · 8924:67388): white, 2px blue/200 ring, r36, soft upward shadow, 20px `message` icon in brand blue + Label2 Semibold copy. ### ProductBoxVertical

`src/components/ProductBoxVertical/ProductBoxVertical.tsx:42`

NoonProductBoxVertical, PLP layout: the search / listing result card, ported 1:1 from bappzaar (`marketplaces/noon/components/NoonProductBox/NoonProductBoxVertical`, rendered by `ProductBox` with `isPLP`). Anatomy, top to bottom: 177 × 241 image box (contain, 2% black overlay; > 1 image → paged slider with the pill pager), "Best Seller" / catalog tag top-left, favourite 24 at 4 / 4, quick ATC 36 at the bottom-end · "{brand} {name}" 14/500 2 lines · rating pill (star first) · price row (sale 16 bold, struck was, "n% OFF") · nudge ticker · coupon tag · express flag + delivery line. No press feedback (`activeOpacity={1}`), as in the app. `wishlist` = `isWishlist` on Wishlist V2 (`isWishlistCompactView`): no top tags, quick ATC, nudges or coupon; `topEnd` replaces the favourite (NoonProductBoxCollectionButton) and `footer` is the bottomRow (marginTop 10, px 8, gap 8).

`src/components/Spinner/Spinner.tsx:44` · props `SpinnerProps`

Loading indicator shared by every flow (bappzaar `src/components/Loader`, RN `ActivityIndicator`). Presets in use: - noon Loader (checkout delivery): `<Spinner track="#DADCE3" color="var(--nk-color-badge)" />` - white loader on a filled button: `<Spinner color="#fff" track="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)" />` - cards PaymentButtonV2: `<Spinner color="#fff" gap="right" duration={0.75} />` - cart inline loader: `<Spinner size={14} thickness={size / 9} duration={0.7} />` - address AddressV2: `<Spinner variant="ios" color="var(--nk-color-cta)" />` Reduced motion (`useReduceMotion`): nothing turns. The ring holds its arc and the iOS petals hold one frame of their fade; both pulse their opacity gently (`nk-reduced-pulse`) so loading still reads as in progress.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|

| `color?` | `string` | `'currentColor'` | arc colour (`ios`: petal colour). Default `currentColor`. |
| `track?` | `string` | — | ring only — colour of the rest of the ring. Without a track the ring is drawn in `color` with one transparent side (`gap`); with a track the ring is `track` and the top side is `color`. |
| `thickness?` | `number` | `2` | ring only — border width in px (default 2) |
| `gap?` | `'top' \| 'right'` | `'top'` | ring only, no track — which side is left transparent (default `top`) |
| `duration?` | `number` | `0.8` | seconds per turn (default 0.8) |

### Toast

`src/components/Toast/Toast.tsx:26` · props `ToastProps<T>` · generic

Self-dismissing toast / snackbar host (bappzaar `src/components/Toast`, `NoonSnackBar`, `AddressToastScreen`): mounts `item` with AnimatePresence, calls `onHide(item)` after `duration`, and animates out when the item clears. The look and motion come from the caller (className + initial/animate/exit/transition), e.g. - checkout voucher toast: fade 500ms linear, 2.5s - address toast: spring up from y 50, 3.4s - cart move-to-wishlist snackbar: spring from y 100%, 3s For a plain message toast use `useNav().toast(message)` instead.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | `T \| null \| undefined` | — | the toast being shown (null = hidden). A new item (by key) restarts the timer and re-animates. |
| `itemKey?` | `(item: T) => string \| number` | `(i) => (i as { id: string \| number }).id` | key of an item (default `item.id`) |
| `duration` | `number` | — | ms from appearing until `onHide(item)` is called |
| `onHide` | `(item: T) => void` | — |  |
| `layerClassName?` | `string` | — | optional always-mounted positioning layer around the animated toast |
| `children` | `(item: T) => ReactNode` | — |  |

Also accepts 336 inherited DOM / React / motion props (not listed; e.g. `className` `style` `onClick` `role` `aria-label` `id` `initial` `animate` `exit` `transition` `whileTap` `layout`).
